sections.content: Combine the pretérito *perfecto* with ya and *todavía* no while talking about tourism and nature. Use the same forms to describe what has happened during the outing.

items.english: We have already explored the market.

items.spanish: Todavía no hemos descansado en la terraza.
items.english: We have not rested on the terrace yet.
We have already seen the region.

sections.content: Keep the auxiliary and participle together. Use ya for completed actions and *todavía* no for actions that have not happened yet.
